episodes.title: Introduction
episodes.description: Introduce American political institutions and compare how government is intended to work with how it operates.

episodes.title: The Bicameral Congress
episodes.description: Explore the origins, functions, and membership of Congress's two chambers.

episodes.title: Separation of Powers and Checks and Balances
episodes.description: Examine how separate branches constrain one another and limit concentrated executive power.

episodes.title: Federalism
episodes.description: Explore the changing division of authority between national institutions and state governments.

episodes.title: Constitutional Compromises
episodes.description: Trace constitutional compromises through representation, slavery, and competing views of federal power.

episodes.title: Congressional Elections
episodes.description: Investigate congressional election schedules, candidate characteristics, and incentives for seeking another term.

episodes.title: Congressional Committees
episodes.description: Explore committees, caucuses, advisers, and the gatekeeping decisions that shape legislative work.

episodes.title: Congressional Leadership
episodes.description: Compare congressional leadership roles and their influence over assignments, communication, and public debate.

episodes.title: How a Bill Becomes a Law
episodes.description: Follow legislation through committees, amendments, votes, compromise, and presidential consideration.

episodes.title: Congressional Decisions
episodes.description: Explore how constituencies, organized interests, and parties influence lawmakers' choices.

episodes.title: Presidential Power
episodes.description: Examine constitutionally stated presidential powers and the limits designed to balance them.

episodes.title: Presidential Powers 2
episodes.description: Explore executive powers developed through practice rather than explicitly listed in the Constitution.

episodes.title: Congressional Delegation
episodes.description: Investigate how Congress and presidents delegate governing responsibilities to federal agencies.

episodes.title: How Presidents Govern
episodes.description: Explore the vice presidency, Cabinet, and executive staff as tools for carrying out presidential priorities.

episodes.title: Bureaucracy Basics
episodes.description: Examine the important and contested functions of administrative organizations in governing.

episodes.title: Types of Bureaucracies
episodes.description: Compare agencies' structures, relationships with the presidency, regulatory functions, and corporate-style responsibilities.

episodes.title: Controlling Bureaucracies
episodes.description: Investigate oversight mechanisms that other branches use to constrain administrative power.

episodes.title: Legal System Basics
episodes.description: Introduce courts, legal decisions, and the complicated boundaries of judicial authority.

episodes.title: Structure of the Court System
episodes.description: Compare trial, appellate, state, and federal courts within the American judicial structure.

episodes.title: Supreme Court of the United States Procedures
episodes.description: Follow a Supreme Court case through petitions, written arguments, hearings, and published opinions.

episodes.title: Judicial Review
episodes.description: Explore Marbury v. Madison and courts' authority to assess legislative and executive actions.

episodes.title: Judicial Decisions
episodes.description: Examine precedent, political contexts, institutional influences, and judicial philosophy in court decisions.

episodes.title: Civil Rights & Liberties
episodes.description: Distinguish rights from liberties and trace how constitutional protections came to apply against states.

episodes.title: Freedom of Religion
episodes.description: Explore First Amendment religious protections and the court decisions and tests used to interpret them.

episodes.title: Freedom of Speech
episodes.description: Examine constitutional protections for expression, their limits, and differences between governmental and private restrictions.

episodes.title: Freedom of the Press
episodes.description: Consider the press's public-information role alongside disputes over security and harm to individuals.

episodes.title: Search and Seizure
episodes.description: Explore warrants, probable cause, exceptions, and limits on protections against police searches.

episodes.title: Due Process of Law
episodes.description: Investigate fair-trial protections involving legal representation, juries, self-incrimination, and repeated prosecution.

episodes.title: Equal Protection
episodes.description: Explore constitutional equality and the judicial standards used to evaluate unequal treatment.

episodes.title: Sex Discrimination
episodes.description: Examine workplace discrimination against women and the courts' intermediate standard of review.

episodes.title: Discrimination
episodes.description: Explore discrimination affecting marginalized communities and governmental responses to their struggles for equality.

episodes.title: Affirmative Action
episodes.description: Examine the purposes, intended beneficiaries, and continuing debate surrounding affirmative-action policies.

episodes.title: Public Opinion
episodes.description: Explore the ways citizens' views influence elected representatives and the limits of that influence.

episodes.title: Shaping Public Opinion
episodes.description: Investigate how ideology, government, organized interests, and media contribute to political opinions.

episodes.title: Political Ideology
episodes.description: Compare liberal and conservative viewpoints while distinguishing ideologies from party membership.

episodes.title: Election Basics
episodes.description: Explore representative elections and the historical changes that shaped American voting arrangements.

episodes.title: Gerrymandering
episodes.description: Investigate how redrawing districts for partisan advantage can influence electoral outcomes.

episodes.title: How Voters Decide
episodes.description: Examine party attachment, issues, and personal impressions as influences on voting choices.

episodes.title: Political Campaigns
episodes.description: Explore campaign purposes, their extended timelines, and the reasons they require substantial funding.

episodes.title: Political Parties
episodes.description: Investigate parties as organizations seeking governmental control and the functions they perform.

episodes.title: Party Systems
episodes.description: Trace changing party coalitions and policies across successive periods of American political history.

episodes.title: Interest Groups
episodes.description: Explore how organized interests make policy demands and use money to influence politics.

episodes.title: Interest Group Formation
episodes.description: Investigate incentives for group membership, lobbying, and efforts to limit organized influence.

episodes.title: Media Institution
episodes.description: Compare media forms and how producers and audiences shape political information.

episodes.title: Media Regulation
episodes.description: Explore governmental influence over media through licensing, potential lawsuits, fines, and legislation.

episodes.title: Market Economy
episodes.description: Examine how government establishes market systems and responds to their limitations.

episodes.title: Government Regulation
episodes.description: Explore economic policy goals, regulatory tools, and debates over government's changing economic role.

episodes.title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy
episodes.description: Compare central-bank interest-rate decisions with governmental taxing and spending approaches.

episodes.title: Social Policy
episodes.description: Explore policies addressing risk, opportunity, and poverty through programs including Social Security and welfare.

episodes.title: Foreign Policy
episodes.description: Investigate diplomacy, security, rights, economics, and environmental concerns in international policy.
